de: EU leaders are set to agree on the next long-term budget by the end of this year. Reuters reports.

de: The prospect of Ukraine becoming a member of the European Union in 2030 is far from reality. This opinion was expressed by Ukrainian economist Alexey Kushch on the air of the TV channel “News.Live”.
